# @ioi-dev/vue-table

> Vue 3 data table component — performance-first, headless-core, CSS-optional.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @ioi-dev/vue-table
```

```js
import { IoiTable } from '@ioi-dev/vue-table'
import '@ioi-dev/vue-table/styles.css' // required for default theme
```

## Quick API

- Props: `columns`, `rows`, `rowKey`, `selectionMode`, `selectedRowKeys`, `pageSize`, `showPagination`, `pageSizeOptions`, `dataMode`, `serverOptions`, `height`, `rowHeight`
- Events: `row-click`, `cell-commit`, `selection-change`, `update:selectedRowKeys`, `pagination-change`, `update:pageIndex`, `update:pageSize`, `state-change`
- Slots: `cell`, `header`, `header-filter`, `pagination`, `expanded-row`
- Exposed methods: `toggleRow`, `clearSelection`, `startEdit`, `commitEdit`, `cancelEdit`, `setGlobalSearch`, `exportCSV`

## CSS Themes

- Default: `import '@ioi-dev/vue-table/styles.css'`
- Minimal (no colors): `import '@ioi-dev/vue-table/minimal.css'`
- Shadcn: `import '@ioi-dev/vue-table/themes/shadcn.css'` (add after styles.css)

## Full Docs

See ai-installation.md for detailed integration instructions and llms-full.txt for the complete API reference.
